# prescribed conduct

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:prescribedConduct`](gmeow-prescribedConduct.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/prescribedConduct>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The conduct the norm is about — an event type, a goal (teleology design), a situation, or a rights action (via the rights graft). The range is intentionally open (the [`tenurePosition`](gmeow-tenurePosition.md) precedent): asserting a closed range union would either dangle across module boundaries or vanish from the generated schema surface, and the graft would force dual-typing of the [`RightsAction`](../classes/gmeow-RightsAction.md) vocabulary. NOT functional: one norm may govern several conducts jointly.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name what a norm is about — an event type, a teleology goal, a situation, or a rights action — the deontic force ranging over the teleology and event spines.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting a closed range union here (the range is intentionally open across modules) and avoid forcing one conduct, since a norm may govern several jointly.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:prescribedConduct`](gmeow-prescribedConduct.md) at the governed conduct (an [`EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md), a [`Goal`](../classes/gmeow-Goal.md), a Situation, or a [`RightsAction`](../classes/gmeow-RightsAction.md) via the graft's [`gmeow:ruleAction`](gmeow-ruleAction.md) specialization); list several when one norm governs them jointly.
